A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have demonstrated a high conversion efficiency of the dye laser pumped by a second harmonic of a YAG:Nd laser.
the use of the YAG:Nd laser as a pump source for the dye laser is a very efficient method of obtaining a high-power, quasi-cw laser with a high spectral stability.
we were the first to use a quasi-cw laser with a pulse repetition frequency of ~100 kHz for pumping a dye laser with a narrow spectral width.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the use of dispersive prism resonators in quasi-cw dye lasers pumped with the second harmonic of cw-pumped Yag:Nd3+ lasers allows one to achieve high conversion efficiency, narrow spectral width, and high pulse repetition frequency (several hundred kilohertz) in a single laser system.
the laser is capable of producing high-quality output pulses in a quasi-cw regime at high repetition rates.

the use of a prism in the resonator of a dye laser with a cw-pumped solid-state laser as a pumping source is a promising way of achieving a high conversion efficiency and a narrow spectral line width.
